briefing: Henry of Trastámara's intervention has displaced Pedro from much of Castile; the crown remains contested. Castilian possession, a claimant's title and access to outside forces differ. material_context.statement: Musters, accounts, retinues and service periods need separate evidence. An indexed name is not proof of current presence, loyalty or readiness.
The 1349 ordinance and 1351 statute attempted to constrain wages and labour mobility after plague. Legal rules do not establish local compliance, individual status or market prices.
The 1362 pleading statute forms part of changing legal language. French, English and Latin usage depends on context; a statute does not give everyone identical speech or literacy.

England’s 1290 expulsion forms part of the legal background facing Jewish people. It does not prove universal absence, uniform identity or individual conduct. Locality and personal circumstances need evidence.
